# jumpcloud_user_group (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a JumpCloud user group by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jumpcloud_user_group" "example" {
  name = "Engineering"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the user group. Exactly one of id or name must be specified.
- `name` (String) The name of the user group. Exactly one of id or name must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the user group.
- `membership_method` (String) Membership method of the user group.
